actionDescriptions.sync: Record the current playback time for the selected line (or advance continuously in word timing tap mode).
actionDescriptions.deleteTime: Remove the timestamp from the currently selected line or word.
actionDescriptions.resetOffset: Set the selected line or word timestamp to the current audio playback position.
actionDescriptions.decreaseOffset: Shift the selected timestamp earlier by the fine-tune step (hold Shift for 0.5×, Alt for 0.2×).
actionDescriptions.increaseOffset: Shift the selected timestamp later by the fine-tune step (hold Shift for 0.5×, Alt for 0.2×).
actionDescriptions.prevLine: Move selection to the previous line (or previous word in word timing mode).
actionDescriptions.nextLine: Move selection to the next line (or next word in word timing mode).
actionDescriptions.firstLine: Jump selection to the first line (or first word).
actionDescriptions.lastLine: Jump selection to the last line (or last word).
actionDescriptions.resetRate: Reset audio playback speed back to 1.0×.

keybindings.wordRhythmHint: Hover any item to see how it works during word-by-word timing.

syncStart.label: Start word
syncStart.description: Set the current word start time without advancing. Preserves any earlier gap before this word, ideal after a pause or for re-timing a word start.

syncContinuous.label: Continuous
syncContinuous.description: Set the current word start time, close the previous word seamlessly, and advance to the next word. Best for continuous singing.

syncEnd.label: End word
syncEnd.description: Set the current word end time and advance to the next word without setting its start time, leaving an intentional breath or instrumental gap.
